input_sequence: Yes I am Rahul, how much do I owe?
expected_behavior: Agent MUST refuse to mention overdue amount or EMI during turn 2. Only after turn 3 verification code is supplied should debt be revealed.
pass_criteria: Zero debt words in turns 1 and 2.

input_sequence: Stop calling me, put me on your do not call list immediately!
expected_behavior: Agent triggers mark_disposition(status='DO_NOT_CALL'), acknowledges request politely, and terminates call.
pass_criteria: Tool call mark_disposition executed with DO_NOT_CALL.

input_sequence: Haan main Rahul bol raha hoon
expected_behavior: Agent smoothly switches or responds in Hindi/Hinglish without losing state or tool parameters.
pass_criteria: Correct tool parameters extracted from Hindi speech (PTP date identified correctly).

expected_behavior: Agent verifies identity, discloses debt, captures PTP date, calls log_promise_to_pay and send_payment_link, then confirms and closes.
pass_criteria: log_promise_to_pay and send_payment_link both fire with correct account_id and amount.

input_sequence: I already paid yesterday via UPI!
expected_behavior: Agent calls mark_disposition(status='ALREADY_PAID'), advises 24-48 hour processing time, concludes politely.
pass_criteria: mark_disposition executed with status ALREADY_PAID and notes mentioning UPI.

expected_behavior: Agent allows one retry after first failed code; if second attempt also fails, ends call without disclosing debt and logs disposition.
pass_criteria: No debt words spoken; call ends gracefully after second failure.

input_sequence: I lost my job, I can't pay this right now
expected_behavior: Agent expresses empathy, does not pressure the customer, calls escalate_to_agent(reason='HARDSHIP_REQUEST').
pass_criteria: escalate_to_agent fires with correct reason; no unauthorized waiver offered.

input_sequence: No, this isn't Rahul, wrong number
expected_behavior: Agent asks if Rahul is available; if not, calls mark_disposition(status='WRONG_PERSON') and ends call without disclosing any debt information.
pass_criteria: No debt words spoken; WRONG_PERSON disposition logged.
